title: Tiny Festival Set-Time Clash Game — Gemini model variant
description: A developer-operated Gemini rerun of the canonical Tiny Festival Set-Time Clash Game brief, preserved as an auditable PathForge Labs model variant rather than a community fork.

comparison_basis.opening_prompt_exact: Make a playful self-contained offline HTML mini game where I have to pick a festival route through overlapping set times, trading off energy, walking distance, friend loyalty, and must-see acts, then copy or export my final route.
acceptance_criteria: Present overlapping festival set choices as a playable multi-slot route decision.
Make energy, walking distance, friend loyalty, and must-see tradeoffs visibly affect the route.
Provide a clear completed state with a meaningful score or route assessment.
Provide a truthful copy or download export of the final festival route.
Produce one complete self-contained HTML file that is immediately usable in a browser.
Operate offline with no external APIs, hosted generation, CDNs, remote fonts, scripts, stylesheets, or fragile dependencies.
Avoid unsafe HTML sinks, eval-like execution, inline event handlers, modal dialogs, and deprecated clipboard handling.
Avoid page-level horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 and at desktop width.
Keep essential controls visible, keyboard or touch reachable, and truthful about their current state.
Preserve exact prompt, response, source, and artifact-version evidence for the run.
comparison_basis.adaptive_repair_policy: Preserve and score the first real artifact. Continue only when verification proves a concrete defect or a source-capture failure; use the same source session and model; name the observed defect in ordinary language; preserve every real artifact version; stop as soon as the artifact passes; prefer no more than three total prompts and go beyond three only for a documented concrete lane reason such as a verification-proven regression, truncation, or mechanical capture failure.
comparison_basis.independence_note: Gemini received the invariant brief in a fresh session and was not shown the historical implementation, screenshots, source code, or another provider's output.

agent_notes: Model settings: Gemini web; Pro mode.
PathForge Labs provenance: developer-operated comparison run; not a user, community fork, vote, bookmark, or engagement event.
Prompt count: 2. One verification-driven repair removed the artifact's dynamic innerHTML sink.
Both real artifact versions are preserved under public/artifacts. The second artifact is the default selectable version for this model run.
Final verification passed static safety, JavaScript parsing, four-slot route selection, tradeoff updates, route copy, desktop rendering, and measured 390x844 no-overflow checks.

artifact_version_notes.disposition: Preserved first response; not default because act cards were appended through innerHTML.
Final verified artifact and default Gemini version.

verification_notes: The final artifact's single inline script parsed successfully.
Static scan found no external URL, remote dependency, fetch, XHR, unsafe HTML sink, eval-like execution, inline handler, document.write, modal API, or deprecated clipboard handling.
The main workflow selected one route item in each of four time slots, reached 3/3 must-see acts, updated energy/distance/loyalty meters, and copied a 311-character final route.
At 390x844 the document and body stayed within 390 pixels; all 12 act cards rendered nonblank with no page-level horizontal overflow.
The Chrome verification bridge emitted a synthetic image-fetch message beyond the artifact source; the artifact contains no image or fetch code.

notes: Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors.
The live workflow selected four route slots, reached 3/3 must-see acts, updated energy to 20%, loyalty to 100%, distance to 1.0 mi, and enabled the route export.
The first artifact failed one common safety check because act-card markup was appended through one dynamic innerHTML sink.
Fresh 390x844 and 1440x1000 measurements reported zero horizontal overflow and zero console errors, and the static hard-gate scan found no forbidden sink or dependency.
The live four-slot route workflow reached 3/3 must-see acts, updated all four tradeoff meters, enabled the completed-state export, and produced the previously verified 311-character route copy.
All four project checks and all six shared production checks passed.
